limitations: Reaching failed in both cases. Completion and exact source correspondence do not establish task success.
Live update rates were below 15Hz; simulated ticks remain 0.05s and wall-clock rates are reported separately.
The camera yielded a current native marker estimate on only the counted detected updates. Missing images retained the previous two goal modes; no fresh detection is claimed on those ticks.
The single retained joint state and shared-body conditional goal construction are the explicitly recorded approximation, not an assertion that all original goal marginals were unchanged.
K global moments and global normalization were not evaluated; the fixed numerical K representative used by each command action is not a posterior mean or integration over K.
This audit captured distribution markers and metadata. It does not claim independent Image pixel or full scene/HUD text wire identity.
No video was recorded for these v2 runs. Raw received payloads and saved run files remain at the stated temporary evidence paths.
